entities.summary: Robert Kenneth Mailhouse is an American actor and musician. He has appeared in television series including the soap opera Days of Our Lives and the sitcom Seinfeld. He is the drummer and founding member alongside bassist Keanu Reeves for the grunge-alternative rock band Dogstar. He also plays in the band Becky.
